Michael Fassbender returns for a new season of The Agency - Streaming June 21 exclusively on Paramount+. #TheAgency

Betrayed, compromised, and haunted by the woman he couldn’t save, CIA agent Martian’s world unravels as a mole hunt plunges London Station into chaos. As loyalties fracture, the truth becomes a weapon – and Martian’s only way out is deeper in. 

Series stars Michael Fassbender, Jeffrey Wright, with Jodie Turner-Smith and Richard Gere.
